label: General
headline: From ambiguous problems
to working, maintainable systems.
summary: Since 2009, I have taken software and cross-domain projects from requirements through delivery and maintenance. My strength is owning the complete technical path and resolving problems at the boundaries between system components.

freelance: Own independent software engagements across Windows, Linux, web, data workflows, and automation—from problem definition and architecture through delivery and refinement.
In hardware-backed projects, owned board design, interface definition, and the coordinated development of device and application software.
security: Combined security analysis, penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and reverse engineering with patch development for government infrastructure.
Converted findings into fixes, verification steps, and guidance that infrastructure teams could act on—not reports that stopped at discovery.
company: Co-founded a private software company and shared ownership of technical direction, implementation, integration, and delivery.
Developed scalable distributed mobile and web products backed by NoSQL data stores and carried obligations through completion.
